scientific_integrity: Explicitly credits known entropy theorem and classic code enumeration; all formal identities shown and proof does not infer infinite results from finite tests.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the single power-of-two even-shift interspersion. Exact counts and natural-boundary proof are mathematical, supported by finite checks only for low periods. General decorated-code counting is classical and the entropy equation is covered by prior work. Historical-priority uncertainty remains for unindexed renewal-system formulae and partly inaccessible Hong (2011); no independent validation has been performed.
title: Two entropy scales and a natural zeta boundary for the power-of-two even-shift interspersion
